name: Whitney
source:
Whitney is an upbeat, talkative girl with an overwhelmingly positive attitude. Whitney excels in sports and she's the ace pitcher and lead-off hitter for Kobukan Academy's women's baseball team. She is also Flannery's roommate.

Whitney was first introduced in Pokémon Gold and Pokémon Silver versions.
